keyPoints.en: A graph G = (V, E): a set of vertices V and edges E. A network is a graph used to model real connections.
keyPoints.bm: Graf G = (V, E): set bucu V dan tepi E. Rangkaian ialah graf yang memodelkan hubungan sebenar.

keyPoints.en: Degree = number of edges at a vertex (loops count 2). Σ degrees = 2 × number of edges.
keyPoints.bm: Darjah = bilangan tepi pada bucu (gelung dikira 2). Σ darjah = 2 × bilangan tepi.

keyPoints.en: Types: simple (no loops/multiple edges), directed (arrows), weighted (values on edges), undirected.
keyPoints.bm: Jenis: mudah (tiada gelung/berbilang tepi), terarah (anak panah), berpemberat (nilai pada tepi), tidak terarah.

keyPoints.en: A tree is connected with no cycles and has V − 1 edges. A subgraph is part of a graph.
keyPoints.bm: Pokok terkait tanpa kitaran dan mempunyai V − 1 tepi. Subgraf ialah sebahagian graf.

keyPoints.en: Applications: shortest or cheapest route, minimum-cost connections (tree), scheduling, social networks.
keyPoints.bm: Aplikasi: laluan terpendek atau termurah, sambungan kos minimum (pokok), penjadualan, rangkaian sosial.

question.en: A graph has 7 vertices and every vertex has degree 2. How many edges are there?
question.bm: Satu graf mempunyai 7 bucu dan setiap bucu berdarjah 2. Berapakah bilangan tepi?

tip.en: When listing routes, check every possible path — a longer-looking route may be cheaper.
tip.bm: Apabila menyenaraikan laluan, semak setiap laluan yang mungkin — laluan yang nampak panjang mungkin lebih murah.
